title: Scheme-theoretic union of two closed subschemes
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $i':Z'\to X$, $i'':Z''\to X$ be closed immersions [def-weil-closed-immersion] with ideal sheaves $\mathcal I'=\ker(\mathcal O_X\to i'_*\mathcal O_{Z'})$ and $\mathcal I''=\ker(\mathcal O_X\to i''_*\mathcal O_{Z''})$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]. Then $\mathcal I'\cap\mathcal I''$ is a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals of $\mathcal O_X$; let $i''':Z'''\to X$ be the closed immersion it defines (the *scheme-theoretic union* $Z'\cup Z''$; on an affine open $U=\operatorname{Spec}A$ of $X$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] where $Z'\cap U$, $Z''\cap U$ are cut out by ideals $I,J\subseteq A$ it is $\operatorname{Spec}(A/(I\cap J))\to\operatorname{Spec}A$). Then: (a) the underlying set $i'''(Z''')$ equals $i'(Z')\cup i''(Z'')$; (b) there are closed immersions $a':Z'\to Z'''$ and $a'':Z''\to Z'''$ with $i'''\circ a'=i'$ and $i'''\circ a''=i''$.

source.place: Morphisms, Definition 0C4H (definition-scheme-theoretic-intersection-union) and Lemma 0C4J (lemma-scheme-theoretic-union), first sentence and the affine-local description in its proof ($(X\cup Y)\cap U$ corresponds to $I\cap J$); closed immersions via Lemma 01QP (lemma-closed-immersion-ideals, cited in the proof of 0C4J); (a) from $V(I\cap J)=V(I)\cup V(J)$

proof.text: Construction of $Z'''$. By [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], $\mathcal I'$ and $\mathcal I''$ are quasi-coherent sheaves of ideals of $\mathcal O_X$, with $\mathcal I'(U)=\ker(\mathcal O_X(U)\to\mathcal O_{Z'}(i'^{-1}U))$ and likewise for $\mathcal I''$. By [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-ideal-intersection] the sheaf of ideals $\mathcal I'\cap\mathcal I''$ is quasi-coherent, with $(\mathcal I'\cap\mathcal I'')(U)=\mathcal I'(U)\cap\mathcal I''(U)$ for every affine open $U$. By [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-ideal-closed-subscheme] there is a closed immersion $i''':Z'''\to X$ whose ideal sheaf $\ker(\mathcal O_X\to i'''_*\mathcal O_{Z'''})$ is $\mathcal I'\cap\mathcal I''$, and for every affine open $U=\operatorname{Spec}A$ of $X$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], with $I=\mathcal I'(U)$, $J=\mathcal I''(U)$ (the ideals cutting out $Z'\cap U$, $Z''\cap U$), $i'''^{-1}(U)\to U$ is $\operatorname{Spec}(A/(I\cap J))\to\operatorname{Spec}A$. This is the scheme-theoretic union of Definition 0C4H and the affine-local description in the proof of Lemma 0C4J.

source.place: Morphisms, Definition 0C4H (definition-scheme-theoretic-intersection-union), via Lemma 01QQ (lemma-closed-immersion-bijection-ideals) cited before it; proof of Lemma 0C4J (lemma-scheme-theoretic-union): '(X cup Y) cap U corresponds to I cap J'

proof.text: (a) The underlying set. Let $U\subseteq X$ be an affine open, $A=\mathcal O_X(U)$, $I=\mathcal I'(U)$, $J=\mathcal I''(U)$, and for $x\in U$ let $\mathfrak p_x\subset A$ be the prime of $x$ under $U\cong\operatorname{Spec}A$ [lem-weil-pbc-affine-open-spec-points]. By [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-image-zero-locus] applied to $i'$, $i''$ and $i'''$ (whose ideal on $U$ is $I\cap J$ by step 1), $i'(Z')\cap U=\{x\in U: I\subseteq\mathfrak p_x\}$, $i''(Z'')\cap U=\{x\in U: J\subseteq\mathfrak p_x\}$ and $i'''(Z''')\cap U=\{x\in U: I\cap J\subseteq\mathfrak p_x\}$. By [lem-weil-pbc-zero-locus-ideal-intersection], $V(I\cap J)=V(I)\cup V(J)$ in $\operatorname{Spec}A$, so $I\cap J\subseteq\mathfrak p_x$ iff $I\subseteq\mathfrak p_x$ or $J\subseteq\mathfrak p_x$, hence $i'''(Z''')\cap U=(i'(Z')\cup i''(Z''))\cap U$. Since the affine opens cover $X$ [def-pc-scheme], $i'''(Z''')=i'(Z')\cup i''(Z'')$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma 00E0 (algebra-lemma-Zariski-topology) part (9), V(I) cup V(J) = V(I cap J), applied on each affine open with the affine-local description of the proof of Morphisms, Lemma 0C4J

proof.text: (b) The closed immersions $a',a''$. The ideal sheaf $\mathcal I'\cap\mathcal I''$ of $i'''$ (step 1) is contained in $\mathcal I'$ and in $\mathcal I''$. By [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-factor-ideal-inclusion] applied to $i=i'$ and the closed immersion $i'''$ there is a morphism $a':Z'\to Z'''$ with $i'''\circ a'=i'$, and $a'$ is a closed immersion; applied to $i=i''$ and $i'''$ it gives a closed immersion $a'':Z''\to Z'''$ with $i'''\circ a''=i''$.

lean.statement: theorem scheme_theoretic_union {X Z' Z'' : Scheme.{u}} (i' : Z' ⟶ X) (i'' : Z'' ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i'] [IsClosedImmersion i''] : IsClosedImmersion (i'.ker ⊓ i''.ker).subschemeι ∧ (i'.ker ⊓ i''.ker).subschemeι.ker = i'.ker ⊓ i''.ker ∧ (∀ U : X.affineOpens, IsPullback ((i'.ker ⊓ i''.ker).subschemeCover.f U) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((i'.ker ⊓ i''.ker).ideal U)))) (i'.ker ⊓ i''.ker).subschemeι U.2.fromSpec) ∧ Set.range (i'.ker ⊓ i''.ker).subschemeι.base = Set.range i'.base ∪ Set.range i''.base ∧ (∃ a' : Z' ⟶ (i'.ker ⊓ i''.ker).subscheme, IsClosedImmersion a' ∧ a' ≫ (i'.ker ⊓ i''.ker).subschemeι = i') ∧ (∃ a'' : Z'' ⟶ (i'.ker ⊓ i''.ker).subscheme, IsClosedImmersion a'' ∧ a'' ≫ (i'.ker ⊓ i''.ker).subschemeι = i'')
